question:
What is the annual average number of sets that were released between 1/1/2012 to 12/31/2015? Indicate the common langugage of the card.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: AVG(id); releaseDate BETWEEN 1/1/2012 AND 12/31/2015; the common language refers to MAX(COUNT(language))

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE XCL_112 BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31') / 4.0 AS annual_avg,
  (SELECT XCL_092 FROM set_translations GROUP BY XCL_092 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS common_language

    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT T1.XCL_095) AS REAL) / 4 AS annual_average_sets,
    T2.XCL_093 AS common_language

JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.XCL_099 = T2.XCL_093
WHERE T1.XCL_112 BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
GROUP BY T2.XCL_093
